# netcup Provider

Terraform provider for managing netcup infrastructure via the CloudDNS REST API and SCP REST API (Server Control Panel OpenAPI). Supports CloudDNS records and domains, virtual servers (VPS / Root Server), reverse DNS (rDNS IPv4/IPv6), network interfaces, firewall policies, snapshots, failover IPs, VLANs, custom images, ISOs, provider-defined functions, and ephemeral tokens under Terraform Plugin Framework protocol version 6.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    netcup = {
      source  = "rixlhq/netcup"
      version = "~> 2.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "netcup" {
  clouddns_api_key = var.netcup_clouddns_api_key # CCP Master Data > API > API Keys

  scp_access_token  = var.netcup_scp_access_token  # SCP OAuth / Bearer access token
  scp_refresh_token = var.netcup_scp_refresh_token # optional: for automatic token refresh
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `clouddns_api_key` (String, Sensitive) CloudDNS bearer API key from CCP Master Data > API > API Keys. Can be set via `NETCUP_CLOUDDNS_API_KEY`.
- `clouddns_base_url` (String) Override the CloudDNS API base URL (default https://api.netcup.com). Can be set via `NETCUP_CLOUDDNS_BASE_URL`.
- `scp_access_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer access token for the netcup SCP REST API. Can be set via the `NETCUP_SCP_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `scp_base_url` (String) Override the netcup SCP REST API base URL. Can be set via the `NETCUP_SCP_BASE_URL` environment variable.
- `scp_refresh_token` (String, Sensitive) Offline refresh token for the netcup SCP REST API. Can be set via the `NETCUP_SCP_REFRESH_TOKEN` environment variable.
